summary: Verified fix for blank-page bug caused by stale service worker cache. Simulated poisoning kn-sw-v2-shell with an index.html referencing /static/js/main.deadbeef.js; after reload the login page rendered correctly (network-first navigation). Header/404 checks pass. Login and both target views render without pageerrors.

issues: Recharts warning: container width(-1)/height(-1) briefly logged before layout stabilises. Not blocking, chart still renders.

critical_code_review_comments: sw.js correctly uses VERSION 'kn-sw-v2', network-first for navigate/index.html and cache-first for /static/*; activate cleans up old cache versions (verified: only kn-sw-v2-* caches remain).
static_server.js returns 404 text/plain for missing /static/* (verified with /static/js/main.deadbeef.js) and Cache-Control: no-store for html/sw (verified via curl).
Consider setting explicit min height on chart wrappers to silence Recharts width(-1) warnings on Designer KPI page.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bug fix validated end-to-end: (1) sw.js kn-sw-v2 network-first for navigations; (2) static_server 404s missing /static/* instead of SPA-fallback; (3) headers no-store on / and /sw.js; (4) poisoning kn-sw-v2-shell with stale index -> reload still shows login screen (network-first); (5) admin login + md-products (catalog-grid) + designer-kpi (design-score-trend) all render with no pageerrors. Cache list after full flow: ['kn-sw-v2-shell','kn-sw-v2-data'] — no legacy kn-sw-v1-*.
rca of the issue: Previous sw.js used cache-first for navigations, so index.html cached before rebuild referenced hashed chunks that no longer existed. static_server SPA fallback served index.html for missing /static/js/* → served as JS, causing parse error and blank page. Fix: sw.js kn-sw-v2 uses network-first for navigate/index.html; static_server returns 404 for missing hashed assets; both / and /sw.js served with Cache-Control: no-store so browsers/CDN never freeze on stale HTML. Verified by poisoning shell cache and reloading — real bundle is fetched.
